label: VitalBreathe
description: Live Tymewear VitalPro breathing data, ventilation zones, a five-minute graph, and FIT recording for Hammerhead Karoo. For training information only; not medical use.
releaseNotes: First public beta, built on the signed test line exercised on Karoo 3 with a live dashboard, five-minute graph, automatic sensor recovery, VitalPro battery, and strict FIT decoding. The final Beta.1 package still needs its candidate-specific hardware check. Treat readings as training information, not medical advice. See VALIDATION.md for the exact evidence and remaining test coverage.
